newsitem.title: USA: EuroGas says OMV buys 2 mln shr option.
newsitem.headline: EuroGas says OMV buys 2 mln shr option.

text.p: EuroGas Inc said on Wednesday that OMV Aktiengesellschaft has acquired an option to buy 2 million EuroGas shares at $4 apiece.
If not exercised within 12 months, the price would go up to $5 in the second year and $6 in the third and final year.
EuroGas also said it has repaid OMV $2 million that was advanced to EuroGas' Polish subsidiary to develop a coalbed methane gas concession in which EuroGas has a net profit interest.
EuroGas said OMV is considering possible participation in a number of oil and gas exploration projects in Central Europe in which EuroGas holds significant interests.
EuroGas shares were trading at 6 at late Wednesday morning, up 5/8 for the day.
